pairs.reason: A shows the full code sample, install and CTAs in the first desktop screen and keeps a CTA on every plan; C's code runs below the fold and its diagram labels truncate.
B's first desktop screen covers install, code, benchmarks and platforms, and its shape-filtering diagram explains sync more concretely; C cuts the code at the fold and loses mobile plan CTAs.
A keeps every feature and a sticky Get started header on mobile; B drops six of eight feature items at 390 and has no persistent nav after the hero.

notes: All three follow the brief with no invented social proof. A's two sub-AA text nodes sit inside the merge illustration, not in primary text. Frames where A's sticky header covers a section heading come from the capture cut, not from the layout.
